```yaml
# This workflow tests btcRecover in a Termux environment via QEMU,
# ensuring both base and full requirements are covered.
name: Termux Tests

on:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at 00:00 UTC

jobs:
  termux-base:
    name: Termux Base Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: actions/setup-qemu@v2

      - name: Run tests in Termux container
        run: |
          docker run --platform linux/arm64 \
            -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/workspace \
            -w /workspace \
            termux/termux \
            /bin/sh -c "pkg update && pkg install -y python && pip install -r requirements.txt && python run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer"

  termux-full:
    name: Termux Full Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: actions/setup-qemu@v2

      - name: Run tests in Termux container
        run: |
          docker run --platform linux/arm64 \
            -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/workspace \
            -w /workspace \
            termux/termux \
            /bin/sh -c "pkg update && pkg install -y python && pip install -r requirements-full.txt && python run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer"
```
